israel.question: Israel or Palestine?
israel.headline: Mixed
israel.headlineWhy: "Mixed" because the items point both ways: {npal} toward conditions on offensive weapons for Israel and {nisr} toward continued defensive aid.
israel.summary: One statement so far, from the newest 30 releases: the member cosponsored the Block the Bombs Act, which covers offensive weapons only, and said defensive aid for close allies should continue.

items.text: Cosponsored the Block the Bombs Act, saying “I oppose providing offensive weapons to Prime Minister Netanyahu and his far-right government without meaningful safeguards or accountability.”
In the same statement: “While I have consistently supported defensive aid for close American allies, military aid for Israel must include strong conditions to prevent further suffering.”
